content.short: SIR offers leveraged tokens with no liquidations and no funding rates.
content.description: SIR issues leveraged tokens that cannot be liquidated and carry no funding payments, shifting the cost of leverage into the token's design. A holder pays a one-time fee at entry instead of an ongoing rate, and the token avoids the volatility decay that erodes comparable products over time. The documentation illustrates the problem with a period where ETH returned to its starting price while a rival leveraged product had already lost value. It is deployed on Hyperliquid and Ethereum.
content.meta: SIR issues leveraged tokens on Hyperliquid and Ethereum with no liquidations and no funding rates, charging a one-time entry fee instead.
